summary: Phase 1 HVAC Job Costing + Customers + rebrand tested end-to-end. 16/16 pytest cases pass (seeded JOB-0001 matches spec $8000/$5500/$2500/31.25%, JOB-0003 flagged unprofitable; full create-estimate -> block-cost-409 -> convert-active -> labor-cost-by-hours*rate=300 -> material-cost -> change-order -> invoice roundtrip; each cost/invoice produces exactly ONE journal entry; trial balance & balance sheet remain balanced; all 4 profitability groupings return items; permissions enforced — accountant/bookkeeper can read, accountant and technician(barber) cannot create; customer create+persist; tenant shows 'Mind at Ease Solutions HVAC'). Playwright flow confirmed UI: rebranded login + sidebar, Jobs table with Revenue/Cost/GP/Margin columns and unprofitable row tinted rose, estimate modal, cost UI hidden on estimate, btn-advance-status converts, labor hours*rate posts (JE# shown), change order, invoice updates revenue card to $5,000, all 4 jp-tab-* tabs populate table-profitability, Customers btn-add-customer creates visible card, Trial Balance page shows Balanced badge, Technician role sidebar shows only Dashboard+Quick Sell (no Job Costing), Accountant lands on Jobs page with no New Job button (read-only).

critical.issue: Duplicate job_number generated. seed.py inserts JOB-0001/0002/0003 directly without initializing the 'job' counter in db.counters. When any user creates a new job via POST /jobs, next_seq starts at 1 and emits JOB-0001 again, so job_number is NOT unique within a tenant. Reproduced in UI (two rows with data-testid='job-row-JOB-0001': 'Northgate Office Park' + newly-created 'TEST_UI_Customer') and in DB (`db.counters` contains {name:'job', seq:1} while jobs already exist for 1/2/3). Fix: in seed.py, after inserting the 3 jobs, upsert `db.counters` with {tenant_id, name:'job', seq:3} — or create jobs via next_seq during seeding. Also recommend a unique DB index on (tenant_id, job_number).

rca of the issue: Duplicate JOB-0001: seed.py inserts jobs by writing to db.jobs directly with hard-coded job_numbers but does not advance the per-tenant 'job' counter stored in db.counters. The POST /jobs endpoint calls Scoped(db.jobs,...).next_seq(db.counters,'job'), which $inc's seq starting from 0 (returns 1) because no counter doc exists yet. Reproduction: fresh seed -> login as owner -> POST /api/jobs -> response job_number='JOB-0001' (duplicate). Mitigation: after inserting the 3 demo jobs, insert/upsert a counter document `{tenant_id: tid, name: 'job', seq: 3}`; additionally add a unique Mongo index on (tenant_id, job_number) and handle DuplicateKeyError in create_job by retrying next_seq.
